title: BritBox Took Its Boldest Swing Yet With ‘The Other Bennet Sister.’ It’s Catapulted the Platform to the Big Leagues
summary: In an exclusive interview on the period drama's record-breaking popularity — and why it's fueled a breakout moment for the North America streamer — BBC Studios' CEO of direct to consumer tells THR: "There aren't others who are as aggressive as we've become in helping to finance the next wave of British television."
